texts.preamble: Sanat Kumar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Thr. on 9 March, 2016 1 M.Cr.C.No.495/2016 Sanat Kumar Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh & others 09.03.2016 Shri Prashant Sharma, counsel for the applicant. Shri B.K. Sharma, Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State.
texts.facts: An application under Section 245 of Cr.P.C. was filed before the trial Court that the standard fixed for vegetable Ghee is changed in the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2011 (in short the 'Special Act') and if such modified standard is applied then no offence is made out against the applicant. The application has been dismissed by the trial Court and revision filed by the applicant was also dismissed.
texts.arguments: In this connection, learned counsel for the applicant has placed reliance upon the judgment passed by the Single Bench of this Court in the case of "Dinesh Chand Kanoongo Vs. State of M.P." {2003 (1) FAC 283} in which it was held that if there was change in the rules that a particular sample is changed on the basis of some difficulty then the standard which is fixed thereafter may be applied to a particular food article and on this basis the Single Bench of this Court acquitted the accused Dinesh Chand Kanoongo. Learned counsel for the applicant has also invited the attention of this Court to the order passed by the Single Bench of this Court in the case of "Kaluram Sahu Vs. State of M.P. and another" {1995 (2) FAC 23} which is also dependent upon the same reasoning.
